# Wont Be Told Productions
> Independent production company making films and theatrical productions.

## About
Wont Be Told Productions develops and produces original work for screen and stage: feature and short films, and theatrical productions, from first idea to opening night. It was founded by Christapor Yaacoubian, who is its Creative Director.

The company's line is "we wont be told, and neither should you".

## People
- Christapor Yaacoubian, Founder and Creative Director. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/afunnythingcalledlife/ IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm5161433/
